title: CLAUDE.md Pending Section Sync Workflow
desc: Keep CLAUDE.md Pending in sync with actual work. CLAUDE.md is canonical -- if not there it does not exist.
steps: WHEN: session end, batch work complete, or user asks for todo sync.
STEP 1 git log: git log --oneline --since=last-sync to list all commits.
STEP 2 match to pending: for each [ ] item in CLAUDE.md, if commit covers it -> mark [x].
STEP 3 add new items: new work not in list -> [x] done or [ ] pending.
STEP 4 commit: git add CLAUDE.md && git commit -m chore todo sync pending section.
CANONICAL RULE: CLAUDE.md is only source of truth. Never track todos in conversation only.
ENCODING RULE: CLAUDE.md has Korean -- use wkcodex.sh for edits not Edit/Write tool directly.
NEW ITEM FORMAT: - [x] short description, no dates (git log has dates).
SCOPE: only this repo items. Skip wkappbot core infra (belongs to wkappbot team).

CRLF NOTE (2026-05-25): CLAUDE.md uses CRLF line endings. wkappbot file edit multiline replacements on CRLF files cause double-insertion and whitespace stripping bugs. Use wkcodex.sh for CLAUDE.md Pending updates, or make only single-line replacements where old_string does NOT appear in new_string.

CRLF APPEND WORKAROUND: wkappbot file edit multiline replacements cause 4x double-insertion on CRLF files. Safe alternative for adding pending items: (1) wkappbot file write CLAUDE.md --append --text '- [ ] item' to add at file end, or (2) use --old-file/--new-file flags to avoid shell escaping. Old string must NOT appear in new string -- if it does, CRLF causes repeated replacement.

COMPRESS PATTERN (2026-05-26): when Pending [x] count exceeds 15, group old done items by topic (e.g. 'harness/wrappers', 'wkdoctor', 'caller-hwnd/CASCADIA', 'CDP/Chrome', 'agent-leak-guard', 'nightly-schedule-guard') into one-line topic summaries with key commit hashes preserved. Keep ALL [ ] open items verbatim and the most recent ~8 [x] verbatim. Delete exact-duplicate lines (CRLF appends often double-write). Delegate the rewrite to wkcodex.sh since CLAUDE.md is CRLF + Korean.
author: claude
